title: We Are Rainbow Academy
description: Plot: Final resolution and new beginning, academy's transformation complete | Emotion: Joy, celebration, hope for the future, and sense of belonging | Setting: Rainbow Academy Main Hall, transformed and renewed at The next morning, academy reopening celebration | Characters: Full Company - All main characters, academy community, families, visitors from other kingdoms
lyrics:
LUNA:
We came here as strangers

RUBY:
We came here afraid

SAGE:
We came here with questions

ALL THREE:
And look what we've made

A place where the anxious can find their courage
A place where the perfect can learn to be real
A place where the different are celebrated
A place where we all learn to heal

ALL:
We are Rainbow Academy
Where every color shines
We are Rainbow Academy
Where every story finds

A place to be told
A place to be heard
A place to belong
Without saying a word

We are Rainbow Academy
And this is where we grow
We are Rainbow Academy
And this is what we know

That different is beautiful
That struggle makes us strong
That everyone has value
And everyone belongs

PROFESSOR OBSIDIAN:
I came here with darkness

AURORA:
I came here with fear

PROFESSOR OBSIDIAN:
I came here with anger

AURORA:
I came here with tears

BOTH:
But we found that healing
Comes from facing the truth
That mistakes can teach wisdom
That it's never too late for proof

That love conquers hatred
That hope conquers despair
That when we stand together
There's magic in the air

STARDUST:
In the starlight, we see truth

BLAZE:
In the fire, we find strength

WHISPER:
In the memory, we find wisdom

SHADOWMERE:
In the shadows, we find depth

ALL UNICORNS:
And together we discover
That magic isn't just spells
It's the love that we share
And the stories we tell

Of courage and kindness
Of friendship and growth
Of keeping our promises
And honoring our oath

STUDENTS:
We are the future

TEACHERS:
We are the guides

FAMILIES:
We are the foundation

VISITORS:
We are the pride

ALL:
Of a school that chooses
To welcome every heart
Of a place that believes
Every child is a work of art

Not perfect, not flawless
But precious and true
With gifts to discover
And dreams to pursue

ALL:
We are Rainbow Academy
Where every color shines
We are Rainbow Academy
Where every story finds

A place to be told
A place to be heard
A place to belong
Without saying a word

We are Rainbow Academy
And this is where we grow
We are Rainbow Academy
And this is what we know

LUNA (Solo over company):
That courage isn't fearless

RUBY (Solo over company):
That perfect isn't real

SAGE (Solo over company):
That wisdom comes from caring

PROFESSOR OBSIDIAN (Solo over company):
That time can always heal

AURORA (Solo over company):
That leaders serve others

ALL:
That friends help us see
That when we stand together
We can be who we're meant to be

We are Rainbow Academy
We are Rainbow Academy
Where everyone belongs
We are Rainbow Academy
We are Rainbow Academy
And this is our song

(Building to spectacular finale)
Different but united
Unique but not alone
Rainbow Academy
Is everyone's home!

We are Rainbow Academy!
We are Rainbow Academy!
This is where we belong!
stage_directions: Character Development. The academy's main hall has been transformed overnight by the restored magical energy. The space is brighter, more welcoming, with new additions that reflect the lessons learned. Banners celebrating diversity hang alongside traditional academy emblems.. New portraits have appeared on the walls - not just of perfect graduates, but of students who overcame challenges, who were different, who found their own paths to success. The magical portraits are more interactive than ever, offering encouragement and wisdom to current students.
character_notes:
The academy's main hall has been transformed overnight by the restored magical energy. The space is brighter, more welcoming, with new additions that reflect the lessons learned. Banners celebrating diversity hang alongside traditional academy emblems.

New portraits have appeared on the walls - not just of perfect graduates, but of students who overcame challenges, who were different, who found their own paths to success. The magical portraits are more interactive than ever, offering encouragement and wisdom to current students.

The hall is decorated for a celebration, but it's not just a party - it's a recommitment ceremony where the academy formally adopts new policies of inclusion and support.
